sections.value: Security round 2 for #319 at cb3c4b9: pass. The PR's own diff against main is still tests and testkit only: daemon_stop.rs, testkit/src/tmux.rs and fixture_cleanup.rs. The non-test files in f382cc0..cb3c4b9 come only from the merges of main (#316, #318, #321), which were reviewed in their own PRs. R2 commit 8347b5fc changes only the daemon_stop bound and its assertion messages, plus finish_server_within's panic text ('waited X of a Y budget', which names local test values). There is no new kill, signal, file removal or process launch, and no production read of PIJ_TEST_TIME_SCALE. Round 1 still holds: kills target only the fixture's own private socket and pid, and cleanup removes only the recorded socket and lock (F262). No secrets, lockfile or .npmrc changes. Nothing new for notes_owed.
